experiments.scope: The exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each organizer trial executes the scored search of proof.md 9.1 and 9.8 in the clustered layout, on the instance the proof prices (last chunk, flags 3, counter t solved by step CT): seven outer words from the seed; the 39 context lines once; clusters of 32 members (e1 bits 10-14); representative batches 0 to 3 and the context's last (four-lane) representative batch, 32 clusters; per representative the packed gate key and the universal two-borrow gate on omega bits 0-6, with no T2 lookup on a closed gate; per opened cluster the opening count with its A_B halt, the representative's test (2) and paths, then its five partner batches; test (2); the Q path with the E count and E_BUDGET halt, the packed Y9 path and T1; a passing lane with the PASS_BUDGET halt, the scalar rebuild, the pre-check of 9.7 and the credit test against C_G(T); the joint solver of 9.4 with (G7) and the G15 guard; the exact 120-unit root predicate; for the first certified root, both last-chunk compressions at counter t and the 256-bit test. T1, T2 and gate entries are computed on demand by the rules that fill those tables. In the same run every member of every walked cluster is recomputed straight-line (all 77 lines of step CO) and its omega mod 512 tested against the cluster's two exact prefixes, every member of a closed cluster is tested bit by bit for (2), every T2 entry used is decided bit by bit, every solver call is repeated by the traversal without G15 with real-compression certificates, step CT charts are compressed at the forced counter, every E lane's step-CT message is compressed, and every 8th trial plants a joint root that both traversals must return. The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, the c1 forcing t = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member (member 0 if none): a 55-byte and a 63-byte message. No BLAKE3 library is imported.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits. This is exact: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted and not recomputed by the organizer: members (walked), e_lanes (test-(2) passes, each running a Q path), passes, solver_calls, leaves, roots, certified, units (charged machine units), solver_units (the solver ledger by nodes), opened and closed (clusters), skipped_pass (members of closed clusters that pass (2) bit by bit), checks, mismatches (a solver call above C_G(T) counts as one), notes and halted. Expected per trial: 32 clusters, about 45% opened (proved bound 0.46), about 480 walked members, 53 E lanes and 0.9 passes, about 0.28 solver calls per pass, almost always no root; skipped_pass, mismatches, notes and halted 0. In the participant's local run of this request: 3,690 of 8,192 clusters opened, 122,582 members walked, 13,481 E lanes, 225 passes, 64 solver calls, no root, 428,544 checks, 0 skipped passes, 0 mismatches. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost.
